title: New Jersey's 9th Congressional District election, 2026
description: This race is for New Jersey's 9th Congressional District, covering parts of Bergen, Hudson, and Passaic counties, including the cities of Paterson and Clifton. Incumbent Democrat Nellie Pou, who was first elected in a 2024 special election after the death of longtime Rep. Bill Pascrell, is seeking her first full term in a district that has become markedly more competitive. Republican nominee Rosie Pino, a Clifton City Councilwoman, won a tight GOP primary over attorney Tiffany Burress and will challenge Pou in a district that narrowly backed Donald Trump in the 2024 presidential election. The race is rated as 'Lean Democratic' by the Cook Political Report, and an independent anti-abortion candidate, Terrisa Bukovinac, is also on the November ballot.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this specific race as of the research date.

candidates.name: Nellie Pou
candidates.summary: Nellie Pou is the incumbent U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 9th Congressional District, first elected in 2024 after the death of Rep. Bill Pascrell. She previously served in the New Jersey Senate from 2012 to 2025 and in the New Jersey General Assembly from 1997 to 2012, and is the first Latina from New Jersey to serve in Congress. Pou serves on the House Homeland Security Committee and the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.

candidates.name: Rosie Pino
candidates.summary: Rosie Pino is a Clifton City Councilwoman and the Republican nominee for New Jersey's 9th Congressional District. She won a competitive GOP primary in June 2026, defeating attorney Tiffany Burress by a narrow margin. Pino previously served on the Clifton Board of Education, worked as a bank examiner at the U.S. Department of the Treasury, and is a first-generation American who earned her GED before graduating from Rutgers University.

candidates.name: Terrisa Bukovinac
candidates.summary: Terrisa Bukovinac is an independent candidate running under the 'Save Our Babies Party' banner in New Jersey's 9th Congressional District. An anti-abortion activist who challenged Joe Biden in the 2024 Democratic presidential primary, she is a Tennessee resident who successfully secured a spot on the November ballot in New Jersey. Her candidacy survived a Republican-led petition challenge in June 2026.

forecast.rationale: No district-specific public polling exists, so this forecast relies entirely on non-polling indicators and carries low confidence. Incumbent Democrat Nellie Pou holds the advantages of incumbency and extensive legislative experience, and the race is rated 'Lean Democratic' by Cook Political Report. However, the district is described as markedly more competitive and narrowly backed Donald Trump in the 2024 presidential election, indicating a genuine Republican opportunity. Republican nominee Rosie Pino is a credible challenger with local elected experience, and an independent anti-abortion candidate (Terrisa Bukovinac) is on the ballot. The independent may draw slightly more votes from the Republican-leaning anti-abortion bloc, which could marginally advantage Pou. With zero polls, uncertainty is substantial, supporting a Lean Democratic forecast with low confidence and a narrow single-digit margin.
